title: PH-US-Japan-Australia defense coordination mechanism already operating
summary: The coordination mechanism for the planned Combined Coordination Center involving the Philippines, United States, Japan and Australia is already operating, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said…

blocks.text: The coordination mechanism for the planned Combined Coordination Center involving the Philippines, United States, Japan and Australia is already operating, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said on Wednesday.
